newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes unchanged at 56.70 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes unchanged at 56.70 vs dlr.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unchanged against the dollar on Tuesday amidst thin trade volumes just ahead of the holiday season, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.70 to the dollar -- its opening price -- despite the Central Bank pushing up the dollar by 2.25 local cents in the morning, they said.
"The rupee is well supported at 56.70," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.
"There was not much trading in the market. Volumes are thin and they are not significant enough to affect the exchange rate," she said.
The Central Bank fixed Tuesday's buying and selling prices at 56.0687 and 57.2014.
Overnight call money closed at 13.25 percent with the market highly liquid, dealers added.
"Some people believe there may be a temporary shortage in the money market after heavy holiday spending. So they are trying to get liquid now," a Commercial Bank dealer said.
